endorsements.name: Kyle Osborn
endorsements.label: Advanced Chrome Extension Exploitation - Leveraging API Powers for the Better Evil
endorsements.description: Browser exploitation can seem to be a nearly unachievable task these days. ASLR, DEP, segregated processes and sandboxes have proven to be effective in abating exploits by attackers. Our expectation of browser security is so high, that in addition to bug bounty programs, competitions such as Pwn2Own and Pwnium have been formed around the core concept of weeding out dangerous bugs.

endorsements.name: Kyle Osborn
endorsements.label: Multiplexed Wired Attack Surfaces
endorsements.description: Manufacturers of mobile devices often multiplex several wired interfaces onto a single connector. Some of these interfaces, probably intended for test and development, are still enabled when the devices ship. We'll show you how you can get a shell on a popular mobile phone via its USB port without using a USB connection and we will release an open source tool for exploring multiplexed wired interfaces.
